stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 全周期巩固第 102 天预定间隔复习词群，强化多义辨析与跨场景（AI/时序/具身智能论文、演讲、六级/雅思托福）主动写作。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G030】让步反驳（Concession-Rebuttal）、局限性陈述与外推边界（Extrapolation Limits）；【G035】机器学习、时间序列、生成模型与具身智能（Embodied AI）的技术表达句法。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP006】描述实验执行、基线核查与可复现流程，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 让步反驳（Concession-Rebuttal）、局限性陈述与外推边界（Extrapolation Limits）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 顶会论文 Limitations 章节、Rebuttal 及高分议论文的核心技能：坦诚承认方法或样本的约束条件（acknowledge constraints），同时清楚界定在什么范围内结论依然稳健（robust），并指出何时外推（extrapolation）会失效。
rules: 区分内插（interpolation，在已观测范围内估计）与外推（extrapolation，向观测年龄、工况或分布范围外推断，需更强假设）。
用 While / Although / Despite 承认局限，用 nevertheless / aún / provided that 说明受控范围内的有效性与后续改进方向（warrant further investigation）。
examples: Extrapolation beyond the observed age range requires additional justification.
The discrepancy warrants further investigation, but it does not warrant a causal conclusion.
common_errors: 要么完全隐瞒局限，要么自相矛盾地声称局限毫无影响。

grammar_instruction.name: 机器学习、时间序列、生成模型与具身智能（Embodied AI）的技术表达句法
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 面向深度学习、时间序列预测、生成式建模与具身智能（Embodied AI）写作，训练如何用精准、克制、零 AI 腔的英语句式描述数学符号、分布特性、物理/几何约束、感知—动作闭环（perception-action loop）及实验消融。
rules: 问题与符号定义：用 Let X denote... / Here, N denotes... / We parameterize the predictive distribution as... 保持全篇符号（notation）一致，严格区分标量（scalar）、向量（vector）与矩阵（matrix）。
时间序列与生成模型：严格区分平稳性（stationarity）与遍历性（ergodicity）、季节性（seasonality，固定日历周期）与周期波动（cyclicality，非固定时长）、概率校准（calibration，预测分布与观测频率一致）与锐度（sharpness，预测分布集中度）。

具身智能（Embodied AI）：准确使用 spatial orientation（空间方位）、trajectory（运动/策略轨迹）、velocity（速度矢量，含方向）、perturbation（外部扰动）、closed-loop feedback（闭环反馈）及 physical/kinematic constraints（物理与运动学约束），不把仿真结果（simulation）直接冒充真实物理部署（real-world deployment）。
examples: Time Series & Generative: Forecast calibration concerns statistical consistency between predictive distributions and observations, whereas sharpness refers to the concentration of the predictive distribution.
Embodied AI: The controller enforces velocity and torque constraints while tracking the reference trajectory under external perturbations.
Ablation & Baseline: Removing the seasonal decomposition module degrades performance on long-horizon benchmarks, confirming its contribution to stability.
common_errors: 把仿真环境（simulation）中的策略表现直接写成真实世界因果有效，忽略 sim-to-real discrepancy。
混淆 covariance（协方差，受量纲缩放影响）与 correlation（标准化相关系数），或混淆 isotonic（保序的）与 isotropic（各向同性的）。

grammar_instruction.name: 词形变化、词缀构词与词性语法槽位匹配（名、动、形、副）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 掌握学术词族与常见词缀（-able, -cy, -ify, -ise/-ize, -ism/-ist, -less, anti-, co-, il-/im-/in-/ir-, multi-, over-, pre-, post-）的转换，确保名词充当主宾表、动词充当谓语、形容词修饰名词或作表语、副词修饰动词/形容词/全句。
rules: 严禁词性混填：accurate (adj.) / accuracy (n.) / accurately (adv.)；analyse (v.) / analysis (n., 复数 analyses) / analytical (adj.)；vary (v.) / variable (n./adj.) / variation (n.)。
警惕词缀语义陷阱：predictable 表示“可预测的”而非“已被预测的”；successive 表示“连续相继的”而非“成功的（successful）”；priceless/meaningless 语义受语境限定；bi-monthly 有歧义，学术写作应改写为 every two months 或 twice a month。
英美拼写（analyse/analyze, behaviour/behavior, parametrisation/parameterization）在同一篇文稿中必须统一。
examples: Accurate records are essential for checking the analysis.
Attendance increased in three successive years.
The appendix clarifies the coding procedure.
common_errors: 形容词与名词混用：*assess the accurate of measurements（应为 accuracy）。
混淆同根异义派生词：把 successive（连续的）误作 successful（成功的），把stationary（平稳的）误拼为 stationery（文具）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 描述实验执行、基线核查与可复现流程
expression_pattern_instruction.template: We conducted [experiment/survey] under controlled conditions and verified [readings/outputs] against [ground-truth/reference].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 直接、清晰地交代实验操作与质量核验步骤，避免头重脚轻。
examples: The team verified sensor readings against manual measurements.
Two analysts analysed the data independently.

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 谨慎归因与多因素解释（May Account For / Be Attributable To）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: The observed discrepancy may be attributable to / stem from [Factor A] rather than [Factor B].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 在分析实验误差或异常现象时，客观提出可能成因而不武断定论。
examples: The observed discrepancy may be attributable to differences in measurement procedures.
Measurement error may account for part of the discrepancy.
common_errors: *attributable for / 把可能成因直接写成唯一确定原因。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00800 v. phr.] 分成（例：We divide the observation period into three equal parts.）；[V00801 v. phrase] 分成（例：The records were divided into three categories.） | 本条用法约束：divide A into B；division为名词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: We divide the observation period into three equal parts.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00800 v. phr.] 分成（例：We divide the observation period into three equal parts.）；[V00801 v. phrase] 分成（例：The records were divided into three categories.） | 本条用法约束：divide A into B，不用 divide in。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The records were divided into three categories.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：口头表达常见；较正式用conduct/carry out。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: I did a small study for my dissertation.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00812 phrase] 得出结论（例：It is too early to draw a firm conclusion from the pilot study.）；[V00813 v. phrase] 得出结论（例：We cannot draw a firm conclusion from two observations.） | 本条用法约束：draw conclusions from；结论强度随证据而定。
key_collocations: draw a conclusion from the evidence
scheduled_review_words.example_en: It is too early to draw a firm conclusion from the pilot study.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00812 phrase] 得出结论（例：It is too early to draw a firm conclusion from the pilot study.）；[V00813 v. phrase] 得出结论（例：We cannot draw a firm conclusion from two observations.） | 本条用法约束：draw而不是do a conclusion。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: We cannot draw a firm conclusion from two observations.

scheduled_review_words.lemma: draw attention to the fact that
scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：draw attention to；不要写 attention on。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The authors draw attention to the fact that the sample is small.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：draw conclusions from；过去式 drew。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The researchers drew cautious conclusions from the interviews.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: Literature Review 与研究陈述（SoP）必备短语，比 use 更能体现学术传承。 | 词表跨单元多义对比：[V00816 phr. v.] 利用；依据（例：The framework draws on both interviews and survey data.）；[V00817 phrase] 利用；参考（例：The study draws on previous work but uses a different population.）；[V00818 v. phr.] 借鉴；利用（例：The proposal draws on previous research into student welfare.）
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The framework draws on both interviews and survey data.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: Literature Review 与研究陈述（SoP）必备短语，比 use 更能体现学术传承。 | 词表跨单元多义对比：[V00816 phr. v.] 利用；依据（例：The framework draws on both interviews and survey data.）；[V00817 phrase] 利用；参考（例：The study draws on previous work but uses a different population.）；[V00818 v. phr.] 借鉴；利用（例：The proposal draws on previous research into student welfare.）
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The study draws on previous work but uses a different population.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: Literature Review 与研究陈述（SoP）必备短语，比 use 更能体现学术传承。 | 词表跨单元多义对比：[V00816 phr. v.] 利用；依据（例：The framework draws on both interviews and survey data.）；[V00817 phrase] 利用；参考（例：The study draws on previous work but uses a different population.）；[V00818 v. phr.] 借鉴；利用（例：The proposal draws on previous research into student welfare.）
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The proposal draws on previous research into student welfare.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: Literature Review 与研究陈述（SoP）必备短语，比 use 更能体现学术传承。 | 词表跨单元多义对比：[V00816 phr. v.] 利用；依据（例：The framework draws on both interviews and survey data.）；[V00817 phrase] 利用；参考（例：The study draws on previous work but uses a different population.）；[V00818 v. phr.] 借鉴；利用（例：The proposal draws on previous research into student welfare.）
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The design draws on earlier work on urban surveys.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: Literature Review 与研究陈述（SoP）必备短语，比 use 更能体现学术传承。 | 词表跨单元多义对比：[V00816 phr. v.] 利用；依据（例：The framework draws on both interviews and survey data.）；[V00817 phrase] 利用；参考（例：The study draws on previous work but uses a different population.）；[V00818 v. phr.] 借鉴；利用（例：The proposal draws on previous research into student welfare.）
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The study draws on archived interviews.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：primarily 是主要，不是唯一。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The analysis draws primarily on original council records.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：名词drop in；动词attendance dropped。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The chart shows a drop in attendance.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：后接名词或动名词；不用 due to + 完整有限句。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The analysis was delayed due to missing data.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：后接完整从句；写作中 because 常更简洁。
key_collocations: due to the fact that records were missing
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The analysis was delayed due to the fact that several records were missing.
